g.text: The same coupled equations describe both operating regimes; temperature, bias, and deposited energy set the response.
Compact model: the seed has two temperatures; the propagated domain has a resistance state but no independent temperature or energy state.
Ce and Cph are seed heat capacities. The tiny numerical series resistance is omitted from the conceptual electrical equation.
